item.title: Self-Hosted MACsec Network Encryption: mac80211 vs strongSwan vs wpa_supplicant
item.description: MACsec (IEEE 802.1AE) provides layer 2 encryption for Ethernet networks, securing traffic between directly connected hosts at the data link layer. Unlike IPsec (layer 3) or TLS (layer 7), MACsec encrypts every Ethernet frame, including ARP, DHCP, and other non-IP protocols, providing comprehensive network-level security.
